subject: Next steps and evidence checklist for Nexigen procurement
messages:
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexigen.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09 15:12 -0700
Subject: Next steps and evidence checklist for Nexigen procurement

Hi Laura — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned:

What we captured:
- Economic buyer: Tom Reyes (you confirmed cc to procurement).
- Primary evaluation axes: latency under 300ms median for production routes, data retention policy (90/365 day options), and auditable access logs for 90-day lookback.
- Security gatekeepers: Legal (contract redlines), Procurement (PO & standard SOW), Security (SOC 2 + recent pen test).

Action items / owners (proposed):
1) Redwood: provide SOC 2 summary, pen-test executive summary, and a small sample of anonymized access logs — target by EOD Tuesday (see attachments). (Owner: Alex)
2) Nexigen: confirm procurement contact + PO timing and whether a vendor security questionnaire will be required. (Owner: Laura)
3) Redwood sales/CS: prepare an economics note for Tom + draft mutual action plan for procurement review. (Owner: Rishi / Monica)

Two quick clarifying questions for you: who will sign the final SOW (legal vs procurement), and does legal require a particular data retention SLA to be embedded in the contract?

Attaching stubs here: SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (summary), pen-test-exec-summary.docx (redacted), sample-audit-logs.csv (anonymized rows). I’ll follow up with a shared Drive folder and HubSpot playbook link.

If we can get procurement on a 30-minute sync this week, we’ll bring a short demo of the admin controls and log export flow for their security team. Proposed slots: Thurs 11/10 10:00am PT or Fri 11/11 2:00pm PT — what works?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexigen.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09 17:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps and evidence checklist for Nexigen procurement

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Confirmed: Tom Reyes is the economic buyer and will be included on procurement approvals. I’ve cc’d him on internal routing but he asked me to handle initial coordination.
- Procurement contact for PO: procure@nexigen.com (I copied the address above).
- Legal asks: we have a standard vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — our legal team prefers to see SOC 2 Type II reports and a pen test summary before advancing to signature. They also want explicit language on data retention in the contract (they mentioned a 365-day default unless otherwise negotiated).

I can loop in legal if you want, but to keep momentum I’d prefer Redwood to send the SOC 2 summary and a redacted pen test summary first. On logs: a small sample with timestamps and sanitized IDs is sufficient.

Procurement is flexible on meeting times after they see the packet. Can you get the documents to me by Tuesday morning? We’ll aim to schedule a procurement sync next week after we review.

—Laura
Director, IT & Vendor Ops
Nexigen Health
laura.chen@nexigen.com
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10 09:20 -07:00
Subject: RE: Next steps and evidence checklist for Nexigen procurement

Thanks — quick internal plan to hit the Tuesday ask and prep for procurement: 

1) Alex: finalize SOC2 summary with one-page executive highlights and callouts for encryption at rest/in transit, key management (KMS integrations), and scope boundaries. Also include the redacted pen-test overview. (Due: Tue 10/12 EOD)
2) Monica: prepare the admin controls demo capture and a 3-slide security operations overview showing log export, RBAC, and retention config. (Due: Tue 10/12 noon)
3) Rishi: draft a pricing note tailored to Tom with committed throughput tiers and an example SLA uplift for Dedicated deployment. I’ll also draft a short mutual action plan we can share in the procurement meeting. (Due: Tue 10/12 EOD)

Blocking items: need confirmation on whether Nexigen legal expects a 365-day retention hard-coded or if a contractual option is sufficient. If 365 is mandatory, we’ll propose a technical note outlining retention controls and associated costs for extended storage.

One more ask — if we can get a single point of contact at legal (name/email), we can include them on the packet and potentially reduce back-and-forth.

-Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nexigen.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@nexigen.com>, procure@nexigen.com <procure@nexigen.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12 09:03 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps and evidence checklist for Nexigen procurement — packet attached

Hi all — putting the packet in one place for procurement/legal review. Attached (stubs):
- SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf — executive summary + control scope
- pen-test-exec-summary.docx — redacted findings and remediation status
- sample-audit-logs.csv — anonymized example of our audit export (timestamps + event types)

Also shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cNexigenOnboarding and HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/NXG-2027-09

Proposed short agenda for procurement sync (30 mins):
1) Introductions + scope of evaluation (5m)
2) Review packet content and confirm legal/procurement checklist (10m)
3) Demo: admin controls & log export (10m)
4) Next steps + PO timing (5m)

Suggested meeting slots: Wed 10/13 9:00am PT or Thu 10/14 11:00am PT. If neither work, share 2 windows and we’ll adapt.

Please acknowledge receipt and let us know who from legal will join so we can tailor the packet if needed.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
